listing.name: Pluto Station Builder
listing.summary: Adds a new industry that constructs the Pluto station in orbit and allows the player to control its combat and mining modes.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new industry that constructs the Pluto station in orbit and allows the player to control its combat and mining modes.

description:
Pluto Station Builder — [Early Beta]

Early beta, publishing for initial testing. Not fully finished — expect bugs and rough edges. Core functionality (build station, switch modes, target and fire) should work. Feedback and bug reports welcome.

A Starsector 0.98a-RC8 mod that lets you build the Pluto station from Ashes of the Domain and control it through an industry dialog:

Build — a new Pluto Station Construction industry spawns the station in orbit, restores all megastructure sections, and removes itself.

Activate Combat Mode — station rotates toward the nearest hostile fleet and destroys it with a red laser. Fleets behind planets are ignored (line-of-sight check).

Activate Mining Mode — station rotates back to the planet and resumes AoTD mining.

Shut Down Station — full decommission.

Works on top of AoTD using its official APIs. No reflection, no AoTD patches. State is saved and restored automatically.

Requirements: Starsector 0.98a-RC8, Ashes of the Domain, LazyLib.

Install: drop PlutoStation/ into Starsector/mods/, enable in launcher.

Credits: kaysaar (Ashes of the Domain) — thanks for permission to publish.

If something breaks, send your starsector.log with lines matching [PlutoStation/Combat] or [PlutoStation/Beam].

https://drive.google.com/file/d/19df13cG7kI4FyTWDPdvB20WVPOw4NfAI/view?usp=drive_link
